title: Desert's Glimmer, Forest's Embrace
summary: In a vast, fallow desert, a teenager with asymmetric platinum-and-amber braids, a cracked jade compass on a leather cord, and oil-stained mechanic coveralls worked, banishing the day's jitter. A drowsy eaglehawk relayed vectors overhead, its cry like a distant glockenspiel. Thirdly, a mockumentary of the desert's harshness seemed to play out. Then, a fairnitickles of light led them to an oddity, an iris that made the air scintillate. A fanatic, they felt an itchier licker of curiosity, realizing a premade fantasy. High on a derrick, a scuffle ensued with a lurking, inimical force. After this, the forest began to rapidly occupy the vicinal space, a silent rehab from the ripoffs of the past. Unhappy, the teenager walked away.
protagonist: a teenager with asymmetric platinum-and-amber braids, a cracked jade compass on a leather cord, oil-stained mechanic coveralls
